description: This file defines a comprehensive Android Compose UI component for app settings management, including device info, media permissions, notifications, location, data access, and preferences. It manages user permissions, system settings, and integrates with ViewModel for state handling.

classes.name: InstalledApp
classes.description: Data class representing an installed application with label, package name, and system app status.

methods.name: queryInstalledApps
methods.description: Queries all launchable apps and recent notification packages, returns a list of InstalledApp instances sorted by label.

methods.name: resolveNotificationCandidatePackages
methods.description: Combines configured, launcher, and recent packages, filtering out the app's own package, returning a set of candidate packages for notification forwarding.

methods.name: settingsTextFieldColors
methods.description: Provides color scheme for text fields in settings UI.

methods.name: Modifier.settingsRowModifier
methods.description: Modifier extension for styling setting rows with border and background.

methods.name: settingsPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Return color scheme for primary buttons in settings UI.

methods.name: settingsDangerButtonColors
methods.description: Return color scheme for danger (destructive) buttons in settings UI.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the app details page in system settings.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens notification listener settings or defaults to app settings.

methods.name: hasNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Checks whether the app has POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission as of API 33+.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener service access is enabled.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Checks if device has motion sensors such as accelerometer or step counter.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the device supports assigning the ROLE_ASSISTANT role.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleHeld
methods.description: Checks if the app currently holds the ROLE_ASSISTANT role.
